changelog:
Initial release of the TrueProfit skill.

- Enables powerful profit analytics for e-commerce merchants using TrueProfit MCP tools.
- Supports queries about profit, revenue, net margin, ROAS, COGS, ad spend, shipping, orders, and customer metrics.
- Automatically triggers for e-commerce analytics questions about TrueProfit-connected stores or MCP server connections.
- Provides clear workflows and tool selection guides to answer common business analytics questions.
- Offers guidance on key profit, advertising, and customer metrics, plus actionable data presentation tips.
